answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 39625 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to ask that during reciting the holy Quran from screen is it permissible to touch the screen without wudhu Question: I want to ask that during reciting the holy Quran from screen is it permissible to touch the screen without wudhu? If yes, then why and if no then also give reason. Some Ulama say that TV and screen have pictures which are aqsi so these are right if we keep this point in mind then above situation of touching Quranic verses on screen will be right because they are also aqsi pictures. Answer ID: 39625 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1453/1138/B=1433) At the time when the verses of the holy Quran are visible on the screen it is not lawful to touch it without wudhu, and when the verses of the holy Quran are invisible on the screen then one can touch it without wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
